basis: User-supplied Rv2 official feedback; public actual inputs; fixed official scoring semantics
baseline: Hash-verified frozen Rv2 submitted CSVs, used as model inputs; no replay of prior mock-based selection
mia: Two multivariate nearest-release/background density-ratio views. Empirical conditional background tail calibration; bounded positive evidence addition to baseline logit; do not penalize unsupported rows. Exact self-private negatives remain zero.
aia: Local release-vs-background half-year-window contrast. Change Rv2 only with strong unique geometric link or >=0.8 local time mass, >=0.25 excess gain over baseline, and substantially closer release neighbors. Preserve already-supported baseline times.
parameters: Fixed design constants before actual-output diagnostics; no target-specific parameters or feedback-derived row labels
confirmation: Deterministic independent regeneration, official format and actual-ID validation, invariance tests, source/input preservation; no claim of measured official improvement
publication: Source, fixed parameters, noncredential CSVs and evidence to existing private main; token-bearing ZIP local only
